verdict.rationale: Graphite is a SaaS code-review and stacking platform, so official SDKs are a fair question for it. The evidence documents only a CLI, an MCP server and an IDE extension, which are different interfaces, not SDKs. No official client libraries are documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
